dupe_move_guidance.description: Read duplicant direct-command entrypoints. Movement guidance uses the public world_editor operation files; dupes_control is an internal operation, not a public tool call.
dupe_move_guidance.id: Duplicant InstanceID. Omit to list all duplicants.
dupe_move_guidance.name: Duplicant name. Omit to list all duplicants.
dupe_move_guidance.instructions: Use an ordinary ops scalar or simple quoted text for <targetQueryToken>; JSON escapes are not decoded. Names needing quote/backslash/control escapes or consisting only of a number/boolean are outside this guide; use coordinate batch instead. <itemsJson> is a JSON array. Supply task and preview flags on the outer world_editor request: syntax/capability checks only, without target resolution, reachability checks or move dispatch. Execution needs outer confirm=true and dryRun=false, command confirm=true and batch payload confirm=true. Acceptance is not arrival.
